name: 47406 · Bloomington, IN
findings: ZIP 47406 (Bloomington) has 22 nonprofit organizations. 16 of them (73%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 15 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (80% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 47406 (Bloomington) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list volunteering
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 47406 (Bloomington) list volunteering on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 42% of the typical level).
